create.name: The Feng Shui Society
create.bio:
The Feng Shui Society is a not-for-profit body for professional feng shui practitioners, founded in London on 9 November 1993, when four practitioners (Graham Gunn, Gina Lazenby, Mark Beakhouse and Jan Cisek) held its first meeting. Volunteers elected by its accredited consultants run it, and it keeps a register of consultants and teachers who agree to its code of ethics, accredits training schools and approves foundation courses. For the public it acts as an information point on the practice, with articles on homes, gardens, workplaces and public spaces, case studies, research notes and free calculators for traditional Chinese systems such as BaZi, Flying Stars and the Tong Shu almanac.

Its YouTube channel, started in 2010, holds recordings from the society's yearly conferences, online community days and webinars, alongside a series of interviews with practitioners and masters from several schools, among them Raymond Lo, Edgar Lok Tin Yung, R.D. Chin and Alex Stark. Topics run from classical and lineage methods to intuitive and earth-healing approaches, and the annual Chinese-year talks.

courses.title: Accredited Consultant Membership
courses.description: Yearly membership for practitioners who hold a recognised feng shui diploma or equivalent and want to be listed as accredited consultants. Applicants go through an accreditation step and agree to the society's code of practice.
courses.price: £95.00 per annum, plus a minimal initial accreditation process fee

free_resources.title: Free feng shui webinars
free_resources.description: Recorded webinars the society has hosted with feng shui teachers, each with a short note on the speaker. Free to watch on the site.

free_resources.title: Free Feng Shui Calculators
free_resources.description: Links to free tools for traditional Chinese systems, including BaZi birth charts, Flying Stars maps of a building and the Tong Shu almanac for choosing dates.

free_resources.title: Free eBook: Earth Healing by Alex Stark
free_resources.description: A free PDF book on earth healing by the consultant and geomancy teacher Alex Stark, shared through the society. It draws on feng shui and Native American geomancy.
